goal: Semantic & Fuzzy Product Retrieval Engine with Typo Tolerance & Accent Normalization
context: Customers in Vietnam often type queries without accents, with typos, or using regional synonyms. Build a zero-hallucination semantic search engine using pure standard library algorithms (n-gram, Levenshtein, diacritic stripping, synonym map) that accurately maps messy inquiries to verified database products.
requirements: Implement Vietnamese diacritic normalization and accent stripping
Implement Levenshtein edit distance and n-gram similarity scoring
Implement regional synonym mappings (e.g. ao phong <-> ao polo, ao thun; quan sooc <-> quan short)
acceptance_criteria: Passes accent-free queries, typo queries (e.g. 'plolo', 'somi'), and synonym queries with 100% test accuracy matching correct grounded SKUs
